scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic; finite seeded numerical checks only reproduce formulas and do not certify limiting arguments. No independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a real symmetric two-level positive-definite matrix, with both eigenspaces of dimension at least two.
The beta convergence is local as squared eigenspace error tends to zero and the multi-step statements are for each fixed finite horizon.
No finite-precision, uniform long-time, or general multi-level spectral convergence result is claimed.
Historical priority for equivalent Gaussian-projection formulations remains uncertain.
title: Codimension-only beta law for random-plane ascent with a repeated top eigenvalue
